payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: (from bob-cli-a2.land; proposed by bob-cli-a2 phases a2.1 #1, a2.6 #1, a2.8 #1, a2.11 #1, a2.12 #1, a2.13 #1, a2.14 #1, a2.15 #4) just docs-check fails its two Material template unit tests on athena: tools/docs/tests/test_templates.py::test_templates_in_material and ::test_component_chips_in_material (2 failed, 3 passed via 'uv run --project tools/docs pytest tools/docs/tests/test_templates.py' on bob-cli master eefdeb47) with 'Failed to load extension github-callouts / ModuleNotFoundError'. Root cause: _build() shells out to a bare 'mkdocs' found on PATH (~/.pyenv/shims/mkdocs, also ~/.local/bin/mkdocs: a global Material install without markdown-callouts) instead of the project env, whose default uv groups (dev) do not install the optional 'material' group at all. Fix candidates: run the project env's mkdocs (sys.executable -m mkdocs) and skip with pytest.importorskip('material') when the material group is absent, or have docs-check sync the material group. The tests were added by this epic (bae9468d bob-cli-a0.8, f8ef1628 bob-cli-a0.3), so no standalone task was filed; all-status task search and the one-week task sweep found no duplicate.
